summary.intent: Plan, execute, verify, and ship Phase 58 (IPNS Signature-Verify Coverage) — adding a Rust CBOR decode/verify chokepoint, routing all FUSE resolve sites through it, adding SDK-core symmetry, and a shared cross-language test vector fixture. Then run the full ship loop: audit gates, CodeRabbit review, PR creation, and review thread resolution.
summary.outcome: Phase 58 fully executed (4/4 plans), independently verified (7/7 must-haves, HARD-09 satisfied, SDK E2E 89/89), and PR #544 opened. A post-ship lint CI failure caused by a non-typechecked `.mjs` script was diagnosed and fixed by converting to `.ts` + extending lint-staged/eslint hooks to cover `mjs`/`mts`/`cts`. CodeRabbit raised 4 review threads; 3 were resolved (2 symmetric fail-closed CBOR hardening fixes applied, 1 outdated); 1 large refactor deferred as a todo.

repo: SDK E2E secret mismatch trap: apps/api/.env uses TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only but the sdk-e2e harness defaults to a different value. vitest 3 does NOT auto-load tests/sdk-e2e/.env — must pass SDK_E2E_SECRET explicitly. A mismatch causes silent 401→skip of the entire suite, which an executor misclassified as 'infra-limited'.

scripts/ convention is .ts run via tsx (tsconfig.scripts.json covers them). The new gen-ipns-verify-vectors.mjs was the lone .mjs, bypassing both tsconfig and lint-staged — caught only by CI's full eslint run.
lint-staged glob was *.{ts,tsx,js,jsx} — missing mjs/mts/cjs/cts. eslint.config.js files glob was {js,mjs,cjs,ts,tsx} — missing mts/cts. .mts SDK helpers were silently excluded from local lint.
check-vector-parity.sh is a meta-check that only validates hardcoded file existence — it does NOT run the generator and does not reference the new tests/vectors/ipns/verify.json.
gh pr edit fails on this repo (Projects-classic GraphQL). Patch PR body via: env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh api -X PATCH repos/FSM1/cipher-box/pulls/<N> -F body=@file
Release bot pushes a chore(release) commit to the branch after PR creation. Must verify it is an ancestor of HEAD before pushing (fast-forward is safe; a rebase is needed if commits diverge).
phase.complete flags 5 REQ-IDs (IPNS-05/06, DB-01/02, BYO-08) as missing from the traceability table — pre-existing hygiene unrelated to HARD-09.

Duplicate-key/wrong-typed-key CBOR parsing is an attack surface in the signed-IPNS binding: both Rust (reject duplicate Value/Sequence keys) and JS (strict type-guard before BigInt coercion) needed symmetric hardening.
The 48/89 SDK E2E regression risk class from Phase 51 was re-run and cleared: D-09 non-CAS sequence gate did not break any of the 89 E2E cases.
commit_failed from the GSD commit helper is a known false negative — always verify with git log --oneline -1 rather than retrying.

code.finding: Needed to reject duplicate or ambiguous Value/Sequence CBOR keys and fail closed on wrong-typed known keys — duplicate-key handling is a real attack surface in signed-record parsing.

CodeRabbit flagged that the legacy fallback path does a second raw resolve instead of carrying the legacy response in a VerifyError::Legacy enum variant. Deferred — multi-site enum refactor, DB-authoritative legacy path is low risk.

BigInt(embeddedSeq) silently coerces wrong types (BigInt(true)→1n, BigInt('5')→5n). Needed an explicit type guard rejecting non-number/non-bigint Sequence values to stay symmetric with the Rust hardening.
Converted to gen-ipns-verify-vectors.ts (tsx runtime, added to tsconfig.scripts.json). The .mjs bypassed lint-staged hooks and tsconfig entirely — only caught by CI's full eslint sweep.

workflow: Sequential execution on the feature branch is safer than parallel worktrees for multi-crate crypto phases — avoids cwd-drift, merge failures, and stranded worktrees.

Pre-push commit reword via filter-branch: git filter-branch --msg-filter 'sed -E "1 s/^([a-z]+) [0-9][0-9A-Za-z.-]*: /\1: /"' <base>..HEAD. Verify tree-identical with git diff <old-head> before cleaning backup refs.
1Password SSH signing can wedge transiently during parallel agent commits — not a permanent state. Test with a timeout before asking the user to intervene.
Adversarial typecheck-wiring probe: inject a deliberate type error → confirm tsc errors on the target file → revert. Proves the file is actually in scope, not just renamed.
CodeRabbit re-reviews fix commits and raises new findings. Expect a second review wave after any push; budget time for it in the ship pipeline.
All GitHub CLI calls require env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh … prefix in this environment.
git push and git fetch are blocked in-sandbox — must disable sandbox for those commands.

friction: 58-01 executor crashed mid-task (API socket close) after committing 3 of 5 tasks, leaving FUSE routing uncommitted and JS binding unstarted — required a manual continuation agent.
One executor completed two plans (58-02 and 58-03) when spawned only for 58-02, making progress tracking ambiguous mid-run.
SDK E2E gate was skipped by the executor as 'infra-limited' due to TEST_LOGIN_SECRET mismatch — a misclassification that required a separate agent run to correctly execute the gate.
The .mjs script bypassed all local hooks (lint-staged glob didn't cover it, tsconfig excluded it) and only failed in CI, adding a push/fix cycle after the PR was opened.
1Password SSH signing wedged during the CodeRabbit-fix agent's commit attempt, requiring a manual fallback commit.
CodeRabbit's PR-level review re-raised findings on committed fix commits, requiring a second round of triage and fixes.
The commit_failed false negative from the GSD commit helper required an extra git log verification step on every commit.
